title: Named-root release polish: typed audit route, serialized session status, bounded 409 refusal text, no parallel resume of an in-flight release
outcome: The release audit and status view are type-safe and compact. The audit route is an enum, not a string. Status rows use the serialized session status, and claim_binding doesn't call an idle tokenless holder "active". The full-table 409 refusal is bounded (a summary plus a pointer to GET /api/engram/named-roots) rather than up to 64 full rows in an agent's context. A second identical request does not resume a release that is still in flight.
acceptance: EngramNamedRootReleaseAudit.route is a serde enum (lowercase), and capacity accounting and resume compare enum values
Status rows show the session status as the API serializes it (camelCase), and claim_binding distinguishes an idle holder without a routing token from an active one
The capacity refusal text has a stated size bound, with a test at 64 retained roots
A resume does not run while the original request for that record is still in flight, with a test
